assets.name: medallion-blank
assets.brief: Existing dist/assets/medallion.png. Preserve complete original circular guilloche silver/ivory ring and geometry; remove all interior building, trees, carriage and horse; replace with continuous wavy silver disc texture. Transparent outside. Same front view/material/light.

assets.name: carriage-relief
assets.brief: Extract original lower medallion horse, carriage and seated driver as single transparent cutout. Horse faces right; preserve original bas-relief finish, pose, harness, two visible spoked wheels and proportions. Remove entire coin, city, trees, water and ground.

assets.name: isfahan-qajar-panorama
assets.brief: Wide compact artistic panorama of Isfahan during Qajar period, antique photograph hand-painted and delicately etched in Isfahan miniature spirit. Low city skyline, long brick arcades, modest domes/minarets, cypresses and pale distant mountains. Restrained ivory/sepia/slate, faded paper edges, no modern buildings, text, UI or border. Approximately3:1 composition.

integration_notes: Original medallion and room assets are unchanged.
Use original medallion image for city reveal; animate its masked layer over medallion-blank.
Carriage asset is transparent with a small source-canvas margin. Match its silhouette to original medallion carriage region around x0.30..0.67,y0.65..0.82.
Panorama is an artistic period interpretation, not an archival photograph or exact historical survey. It has ivory faded edges and works with mix-blend-mode:multiply on warm cream.
WebP versions are format-only transcodes of generated PNGs with dimensions and alpha preserved.
